notes.title: Major Update - Easy Mode + New Title Screen + Misc Updates
notes.content:
Easy Mode - Given the game's difficulty, and my kids desire to play Ninja Turdle, I decided to officially build "Easy Mode".

New Title Screen - I gave the title screen / game save selection screen a refresh.



Additional Updates:
- Nintendo Switch Pro Controller support + fixes (Mac M1)
- Minor map + sprite updates
- New Achievement for completion of game in Easy Mode
- New sound tracks




"Is this easy mode?" - D.Va

notes.title: Ongoing Controller support fixes.
notes.content:
There have been some ongoing controller issues related to Mac M1 architecture + LibGDX controller support. This should fix support for Nintendo Switch Pro Controller and a number of other controllers. 

Further fixes are underway and will be pushed out over the next few weeks.

notes.title: New Game+
notes.content:
New Game+ Mode now available!

If you have any save file* that has beaten Ninja Turdle you now have the option to start a "New Game+" save file where you get to start the game with the masks you unlocked for beating the game.

There is also now a NEW mask gained upon completing normal mode. If you have already beat the game, your save file should reflect this after starting your save file.

There are now two masks gained upon completing hard mode.

There are now three masks gained upon completing hardest mode.

* Save files that have been completed are denoted by an "*" after the save file time.

** All masks obtained in easier modes are unlocked upon completing harder modes.

*** If you do NOT want to start in "New Game+" mode, press the "Change Mask" button to switch start a standard new game. New Game+ save files will be displayed as "New - <difficulty>+" in yellow text. 

**** You may still change difficulties for your New Game+ by pressing the D-Pad left or right.
